name: Halcyon Grid
tagline: Storage that keeps the grid calm.
features: Canvas hero: a twisting ribbon of light lines with charge pulses, drawn as a pure function of time
Count-up stats band with charging bars
Accessible solutions tabs (arrow keys) that rebuild isometric SVG scenes on every switch
Investor-relations chart that draws itself in, plus a sample sustainability-report modal
Case studies, careers and newsroom sections with a calm night-and-chalk identity
